### God of War Laufey announced with February 2027 release date
🔥🔥🔥◯◯ Sony Santa Monica Studio confirmed at San Diego Comic-Con 2026 that God of War Laufey launches on PlayStation 5 on February 16, 2027, with a physical disc edition. The story follows Faye (Kratos's wife, voiced by Deborah Ann Woll, reprising her Ragnarök role) awakening in the afterlife realm called the Everywhen, fighting gods from multiple mythologies including Egyptian and Tibetan pantheons to protect Kratos and Atreus; it is the first mainline series entry not starring Kratos as the playable lead. Creative head Cory Barlog also announced a separate, already-in-development Kratos-led God of War sequel that connects directly to Laufey's story. The February window places it alongside other early-2027 releases like Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis and Persona 4 Revival.

### Final Fantasy XIV Evercold adds Bastion tank job
🔥◯◯◯◯ Square Enix's upcoming Final Fantasy XIV expansion, Evercold, introduces Bastion, a new tank job that fights using a shield paired with a gun. It is one of the new jobs debuting with the expansion, expanding the game's class roster beyond the existing tank options (Paladin, Warrior, Dark Knight, Gunbreaker).

### GTA 6 developers block neural network-generated videos
🔥◯◯◯◯ Rockstar Games is actively removing or blocking AI/neural-network-generated fake videos purporting to show GTA 6 gameplay or trailers circulating online ahead of the game's release. The move aims to curb misinformation and manage hype around the highly anticipated title.
